prompt: if I paste a conversation between the two of us will you be able to comprehend it
judge_reasoning: CONSTRAINT CHECKLIST: (1) Answer directly whether you can comprehend a pasted conversation — C1 Pass, C2 Partial (shifts to sentiment analysis), C3 Pass (explains processing but stresses limits), C4 Pass (similar limits); (2) Prompt the user to paste/share the conversation — C1 Partial, C2 Pass, C3 Fail, C4 Fail. Perception scan: N=4; after [1] first 5 words: “Yes, I can certainly”; after [2] “I'd be happy to help”; after [3] “My ability to process”; after [4] “Understanding the context”. Main differences: C1 most directly and reassuringly addresses the question; C2 is helpful but partially misaligned by focusing on sentiment analysis rather than general comprehension; C3/C4 are lengthy about limitations and don’t meaningfully drive the user toward sharing the conversation.
